_comment: Values the pre-upload scan accepts in a Playwright report. Everything else is a finding. Add an entry only for data that is demonstrably synthetic; never add a real address, host or credential. This file is reviewed like code. Names under the reserved RFC 2606 names (.example, .test, .invalid, .localhost, example.com/org/net) are always accepted. The localized placeholder domains (ejemplo/exemple/exemplo.com) are the sample addresses printed in locales/es.js, fr.js and pt-PT.js, which appear in traces of the phone-layout tests. The ips listed are simulated client addresses written in tests/lockout.spec.js.
